```{python}
#| label: setup
import duckdb
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

DATABASE_PATH = "{{database}}"
TOP_N = int("{{top_n}}")
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = [
    "{{report_font}}",
    "PingFang SC",
    "Microsoft YaHei",
    "Noto Sans CJK SC",
    "Arial Unicode MS",
    "sans-serif",
]
plt.rcParams["axes.unicode_minus"] = False

con = duckdb.connect(DATABASE_PATH, read_only=True)
kpis = con.execute("""
SELECT
    count(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
    count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers,
    round(sum(revenue), 2) AS revenue,
    round(100.0 * sum(gross_profit) / nullif(sum(revenue), 0), 2) AS margin_pct
FROM order_detail
""").df().iloc[0]
trend = con.execute("SELECT * FROM monthly_trend ORDER BY month").df()
pivot = con.execute("SELECT * FROM region_category_pivot ORDER BY total_revenue DESC").df()
products = con.execute(
    "SELECT * FROM product_ranking ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT ?",
    [TOP_N],
).df()
```

## 核心指标

```{python}
cards = f"""
<div class="kpi-grid">
  <div class="kpi"><span>订单数</span><strong>{int(kpis['orders']):,}</strong></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span>客户数</span><strong>{int(kpis['customers']):,}</strong></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span>销售收入</span><strong>¥{kpis['revenue']:,.0f}</strong></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span>毛利率</span><strong>{kpis['margin_pct']:.2f}%</strong></div>
</div>
"""
display(Markdown(cards))
```

## 月度趋势

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.8))
ax.plot(trend["month"].astype(str), trend["revenue"], marker="o", color="#b86316", linewidth=2.2)
ax.fill_between(trend["month"].astype(str), trend["revenue"], color="#b86316", alpha=0.10)
ax.set_title("月度销售收入")
ax.set_ylabel("收入（元）")
ax.grid(axis="y", color="#e7ebe9")
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.xticks(rotation=25)
display(fig)
plt.close(fig)
```

```{python}
top_region = pivot.iloc[0]
top_product = products.iloc[0]
display(Markdown(
    f"收入最高区域是 **{top_region['region']}**，收入 "
    f"**¥{top_region['total_revenue']:,.0f}**；"
    f"排名第一的产品是 **{top_product['product_name']}**，"

))
```
